description: React component for a reusable weekly status report form with client-side validation and Tailwind styling.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, updates form data, and clears errors for the changed field.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Marks a field as touched and triggers validation for that field.

methods.name: validateField
methods.description: Validates individual form fields, with 'workedOn' being required and minimum length enforced.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the entire form, primarily ensuring 'workedOn' is filled and meets length requirements.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates form, and calls onSubmit callback if valid.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets form data to initial values and clears errors and touched state.
